en: Black‑and‑white rural landscape showing gently rolling meadows with fences, a few telegraph poles, and several large houses on a hillside. In the foreground is a prominent half‑timbered farmhouse with a steep gabled roof, characteristic of Central European (especially German) rural architecture. More multi‑storey villas or pension-style buildings stand further up the slope against a backdrop of dense conifer forest. The sky is blank and bright, and the overall scene feels like an early‑20th‑century countryside resort or village. Along the right edge there is a vertical strip with handwritten or printed numbers and letters, as often seen on vintage negatives or postcard captions, but it is not fully legible.
